description: This PHP source file defines a console command class 'RestoreDatabaseToSavepointCommand' for restoring a database to a specified savepoint within the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system. It extends a base command class and interfaces with a database backup service to perform the restore operation.

classes.name: RestoreDatabaseToSavepointCommand
classes.description: A console command class for restoring the database to a specific savepoint.

methods.name: getCommandName
methods.description: Returns the name of the console command.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes the command to restore the database to the specified savepoint.
